description: Batch edits + writes + verify commands in one atomic tool call. Edits apply in order with exact-string matching and rollback on any mismatch.

exit_codes.1: rolled back, failed, or invalid request
exit_codes.2: usage / IO error (no JSON, unreadable input)

allow_outside.description: UNSAFE: permit absolute paths and symlink escapes outside the working directory

dry_run.description: validate + return diff previews, write nothing

edits.description: exact-string edits applied in order; multiple edits to the same path compose (each matches the previous edit's result); first mismatch rolls back the whole batch

new_string.description: replacement literal; max 2MiB; empty string = deletion

old_string.description: exact literal text to find; must occur exactly once unless replace_all; non-empty; max 2MiB; NOT a regex

path.description: path relative to cwd; absolute and ../ refused unless allow_outside

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one

verify.description: shell commands run after edits+writes land; use for cargo check / git diff --stat so one call covers patch+verify

cmd.description: run via sh -c in the working directory; verify failure does NOT roll back edits

writes.description: create or overwrite whole files; applied AFTER edits; duplicate paths: last wins

name: patchify
